Brawl Stars is a free-to-play mobile action game by Supercell (iOS and Android) featuring fast, top-down, twin‑stick shooter battles. Players collect and upgrade “Brawlers,” each with unique attacks, a chargeable Super ability, and unlockable perks. Matches are short (about 1–3 minutes) across multiple modes, including:

- 3v3 modes like Gem Grab, Brawl Ball, Heist, Bounty, Hot Zone, and Knockout
- Showdown, a solo/duo battle‑royale style mode
- Rotating special events and limited-time modes

The game includes ranked play, seasonal events, cosmetics/skins, and social systems like Clubs. It’s free to play with optional in-app purchases. Released globally in December 2018, it has an active community and esports scene.
